items.title: NVIDIA Looks Expensive Until You Ask What Has To Ship
items.summary: Consensus turns today's multiple into a much lower one within two years, and by management's own account the constraint on getting there is capacity rather than demand.

items.title: Prediction: Marvell’s New AI Catalyst Could Drive 21% Upside
items.summary: Marvell's AI infrastructure business just posted record data center revenue and management keeps raising its multiyear outlook, yet the stock still sits well below its 52-week high. Here is what the numbers say about whether the rally has room left to run.

items.title: Micron's Biggest Risk Is Written In Its Construction Budget
items.summary: Micron is spending record cash flow on new fabs whose output arrives into the same year its own outlook expects memory supply to improve.

items.title: Alphabet’s Waymo Has Built a Custom Chip for Its Robotaxis
items.summary: Alphabet Inc.’s Waymo has built a custom chip that the company said will improve the performance of its robotaxis, while also diversifying its chip supply beyond third-party companies such as Nvidia Corp.

items.title: The Upside Case For Qualcomm Stock Now Carries Purchase Orders
items.summary: Qualcomm's non-handset business is inflecting fast enough that management expects it to replace the revenue Apple is taking away, and the first proof of that arrives in the December quarter.

items.title: Broadcom Holds Steady as ARK Buys the Dip, Intel Slips, AMD Eases After Google’s Marvell Chip Deal
items.summary: Google just handed Marvell a $12.2 billion equity-linked custom-chip deal, and Broadcom shareholders are left wondering how much of their AI revenue story walked out the door with it.

items.title: AVGO Stock Recovers Premarket After Marvell-Linked Selloff: Cathie Wood Loads Up On The Dip
items.summary: Wood’s ARK Invest purchased $20 million shares of Broadcom on Wednesday.

items.title: AMD and Intel Shares Plummet, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after investors reacted to a significant partnership between Google and Marvell Technology for custom AI chip development, signaling a potential shift in market share.
